reason: A file-handling plugin that accepts pasted or dragged images and documents, stores them in the workspace, and converts them to workspace paths appended to outgoing messages.

summaries.zh: 通过粘贴或拖放接收图片与文件，将其存入工作区并在发送时自动把工作区路径附加到消息中。
summaries.en: Accepts pasted or dragged images and files, stores them in the workspace, and appends their workspace paths to outgoing messages.

capabilities: Accepts pasted or dragged files through the web interface
Uploads supported files to the session workspace under .drops
Intercepts send handling and appends uploaded workspace paths to the message
Renders attachment previews and removable file chips
